extensionDescription.message: Summarize YouTube videos, translate captions, and watch with bilingual subtitles using your choice of AI

aiControlsHint.message: Use custom instructions for domain terminology and tune caption translation context.

customPromptHint.message: Enable one at a time for newly generated caption translations, summaries, and summary translations.

promptInstructionPlaceholder.message: For example: Use official localized champion and item names; keep ADC in English.

promptNameDuplicate.message: An instruction with this name already exists.

promptProfileLimit.message: You can save up to 10 instructions.

translationChunkFastHint.message: Shows the first translations sooner, with less context and more requests.

translationChunkBalancedHint.message: Balances response time, context, and request count for everyday use.

translationChunkContextHint.message: Provides more domain context and fewer requests, but each batch responds more slowly.

customPromptCacheTitle.message: Existing results do not update automatically

customPromptCacheHint.message: After changing an instruction or chunk size, use Retranslate section/all or Summarize again.

promptSyncHint.message: Instructions sync through Chrome and are written only when you click Save.

generalSettingsHint.message: Choose the popup interface language and the target language for summaries and caption translations.

subtitleSettingsHint.message: Control how source and translated captions appear in the player.

subtitlePreviewSource.message: Every idea starts with a question.

subtitlePreviewTranslation.message: 每个想法都始于一个问题。

aiSettingsHint.message: Choose a model and save the API key for its provider.

setupStepChoose.message: Choose an AI provider and model

setupStepGetKey.message: Create an API key in the provider console

setupCompleteHint.message: You can now open a captioned YouTube video to summarize or translate it.

aiTabNeedsSetup.message: AI models, API key setup required

apiKeyStorageHint.message: The key stays on this device and is not synced by Chrome.

apiUsageBillingHint.message: You only need one provider; API usage and charges belong to that provider.

uiLanguageHint.message: Used throughout the extension interface; does not affect summaries or caption translations

outputLanguageHint.message: Used for both AI summaries and caption translations

learningModeHint.message: Show translations only on hover; unavailable when Translation only is enabled

translationOnlyHint.message: Hide source captions and keep translations visible

bilingualDefaultHint.message: You can still toggle each video from the player

dataDisclosure.message: When you summarize or translate, the video transcript and API Key are sent directly to your selected AI provider. The developer does not receive this data.

clearAllApiKeys.message: Delete all API Keys on this device

clearAllApiKeysConfirm.message: Delete all API Keys saved on this device?

popupFooter.message: Open a YouTube video and click “AI Summary & Translation” in the player

bilingualSetupRequired.message: Configure an API key in the extension first

aiSetupRequiredPanel.message: No $PROVIDER$ API key is configured. Raw captions are still available. To summarize or translate, click the extension icon marked “!” in the browser toolbar and finish setup.

loadEarlierCaptions.message: Scroll up to load earlier captions

loadLaterCaptions.message: Scroll down to load later captions

sectionNotTranslated.message: This section has not been translated. Click “Translate section”.

clearTranslationCacheTitle.message: Remove all saved translations for this video. Enabled bilingual subtitles will translate again at the current playback position.

translationCacheCleared.message: Translation cache cleared. Translate a section or the full transcript again.

translationCacheClearFailed.message: Could not clear translation cache. Please try again.

translationCacheWriteFailed.message: Translation finished, but it could not be saved locally

translationFailed.message: Caption translation failed. Try again later.

summaryTranslationFailed.message: Summary translation failed; the original summary was kept

summaryCacheUnavailable.message: Local cache is unavailable; this result might not be saved

errorUnexpected.message: Something went wrong. Try again later.

errorEmptyTranscript.message: No usable captions were found. Make sure this video has recognizable captions.

errorYoutubeCaptionLoad.message: Could not load captions. Refresh the page and try again.

errorYoutubeCaptionUnavailable.message: No captions are currently available. Try enabling captions with the player’s CC button.

errorPageNotReady.message: The page has not finished loading. Refresh and try again.

errorCaptionService.message: The caption service is temporarily unavailable. Trying another method…

errorNoCaptions.message: This video does not provide captions.

errorNoPreferredYoutubeCaptions.message: This video has no Chinese, English, or Japanese captions.

errorNotYoutubeVideo.message: Use this feature on a YouTube video page.

errorContentFiltered.message: The content was blocked by the safety filter.

errorApiKeyRequiredForProvider.message: Configure a $PROVIDER$ API key in the extension popup first

errorApiKeyRequired.message: Configure an API key in the extension popup first

errorApiRejected.message: The API rejected the request ($STATUS$). Check your API key.

errorAiUnavailable.message: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

errorUnreadableStream.message: Could not read the response stream.

errorFirstResponseTimeout.message: The AI response timed out. Try again later.

errorStreamStalled.message: The AI response stalled. Try again later.

errorNetworkRequestFailed.message: The network request still failed after automatic retries.

errorTranscriptTooLong.message: This transcript is too long for the selected model without excessive API calls. Choose a model with a larger context window.

errorTranslationEmpty.message: The AI returned an empty translation.

errorTranslationIncomplete.message: The AI caption response is incomplete or does not cover every source caption.

errorTranslationInvalidLine.message: The AI returned an invalid caption line.

errorTranslationInvalidLineFields.message: The AI returned a caption line with invalid fields.

errorTranslationTimestampRange.message: The AI returned an invalid or out-of-range caption timestamp.

errorTranslationTimestampOrder.message: The AI returned caption timestamps out of order.

errorTranslationAfterComplete.message: The AI returned content after the completion marker.

errorTranslationAttemptLimit.message: The caption translation retry limit was reached.

onboardingSummaryBody.message: Click the highlighted button at the top right of the player to open the panel. Use AI Summary for key points, or Transcript to read captions and jump to a moment in the video.

onboardingSubtitleTitle.message: Bilingual subtitles, right in the player

onboardingSubtitleBody.message: The highlighted button next to YouTube’s CC button toggles bilingual subtitles for this video. Once an API key is saved, captions can appear with a translation. Adjust their language and appearance in extension settings.

apiKeyExplanation.message: An API key is a private access key from an AI provider. It lets this extension ask that provider’s AI to summarize and translate videos.

apiKeyMembershipHint.message: It is separate from your login password or a chat subscription such as ChatGPT. API usage is usually billed separately; check your balance and usage with the provider.

onboardingKeyReady.message: You already have an API key saved. You can now use AI Summary and subtitle translation.

onboardingOpenPanel.message: Open the panel and take a look

onboardingSetupFallback.message: Click this extension’s icon in the browser toolbar, then open AI Models to save your API key.

onboardingReplayHint.message: Open a YouTube video, then click this button again to see the tour.
